resources.string: The ECU is not responding. Check that the ignition is on and the adapter is firmly plugged into the OBD socket. Older cars (K-line) need a K+DCAN cable or similar; a generic ELM327 will not work.
Could not connect to the ECU. If the car is an older K-line model, the adapter type is wrong: use a K+DCAN cable or similar.
The connection to the adapter was lost. Check that it is still connected and try again.
The adapter was not found or could not be initialised. Check the USB cable or Bluetooth pairing and the adapter type selected in Settings.
Permission to use the device is missing. Reconnect the cable and accept the USB permission when Android asks.
The adapter port could not be opened. Check that no other app is using it and that the adapter is properly connected.
The adapter is not responding. Check that it is connected and the car ignition is on.
The SGBD file (.prg/.grp) for this ECU was not found. Check the ECU folder in Settings.
The SGBD file is damaged or incompatible. Check the files in the ECU folder in Settings.
This SGBD does not have that job. The ECU files may not match the control unit version.
The diagnostic service is closed. Reopen the screen.
